item.title: From Reflected XSS to Container RCE in LocalStack via CloudFormation Deploy UI
item.author: cyberroute@proton.me (Alessandro Bresciani)
item.description: CVE Identifiers Update (October 22, 2026): both CVEs are now published on the NVD. CVE Description CVSS 3.1 CWE CVE-2025-65200 Remote Code Execution via XSS to CloudFormation Chain 9.6 Critical (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H) CWE-79 CVE-2025-69723 Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability 6.1 Medium (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N) CWE-79 What is LocalStack and how to quickly start it? LocalStack is a popular open-source platform that emulates AWS services locally, allowing developers to build and test cloud infrastructure without touching real AWS accounts.
